evidence.quote: The following is valid for applicants from: non-EU countries For the winter semester: until 15 July
Prospective students who have obtained their university entrance qualification outside the European Union (EU) should therefore submit their application directly to UNI-ASSIST.

notes: The official programme page is the German-language hs-bremerhaven.de/en/itm (labeled EN) and the DAAD page; both describe the same programme. The German-language Bewerbung page (https://www.hs-bremerhaven.de/bachelorbewerbung) lists a general deadline of 15 July 2026 for non-EU applicants via uni-assist for non-restricted Bachelor programmes, but this is a general institution-wide deadline; the DAAD programme page gives 15 July recurring without a year for non-EU applicants. Application is via uni-assist; no VPD (preliminary review) is mentioned. The semester contribution (438 EUR from winter semester 2026/27) is not tuition. The language requirement of C1 English by the end of the first semester on the German page is stated as a requirement for enrolment but confirms B2 at application for non-EU applicants on DAAD. The maths preparation course is a recommendation, not a requirement.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5
German language skills A1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat A1
